note: The game's effect selection (docs/design/unity-game.md, Weapon and Ability Effects), converted by game/Assets/Game/Editor/Effects/EffectConverter.cs into the gitignored Assets/Baked/Effects/; its fields are demo3d's (docs/tech-demo-3d/effects.md, The converter and The look). The sword's effects are white: the slash, spin and slam keep demo3d's Hovl prefabs without their fire and smoke (the hero stays in sight), through a heat ramp from ice to white. scaleRef is the reach in metres at which an effect has its stock size: the client spawns them at the strike's reach. crystal-burst is demo3d's crystal shatter burst (epic ps-2iq), built in and tinted per spawn by the role's gem colour. hit-flash and structure-burst are built in too.

effects.name: slam
effects.prefab: Assets/Hovl Studio/AOE Magic spells Vol.1/Prefabs/Magic hit.prefab

effects.name: crystal-burst
effects.notes: demo3d's crystal shatter burst: sprayed from where the killing blow lands and along it (the spawn's yaw), bright chips and fine crystal dust slowed by drag and fading out within 0.7 s, tinted per spawn by the role's gem colour

effects.name: hit-flash
effects.notes: a hit that doesn't kill: a few white-hot chips off the body along the blow, gone within 0.2 s (the body's own flash is the crowd's)

effects.name: structure-burst
effects.notes: a structure's break or regrowth: the crystal burst, larger and thrown wider from the strike point, tinted by the site's hue
